title: BitGo and Crossover Markets Surpass $2 Billion in Cleared Volume
summary: Institutional clients have surpassed $2 billion in cumulative notional volume executed on Crossover Markets' CROSSx and cleared and settled through BitGo's Go Network.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


-


**$2 billion in cleared volume:** Institutional clients have surpassed $2 billion in cumulative notional volume executed on Crossover Markets' CROSSx and cleared and settled through BitGo's Go Network.


-


**A model built for institutional trading:** CROSSx provides electronic execution and institutional liquidity, while BitGo provides the credit, custody, clearing, and settlement infrastructure supporting client trading activity.


-


**Growing adoption of traditional market structure:** The milestone demonstrates institutional demand for a model that separates key functions across the trading lifecycle rather than concentrating them with the execution venue.


BitGo and[Crossover Markets](https://crossovermarkets.com/) have surpassed $2 billion in cumulative cleared notional volume through BitGo’s proprietary regulated settlement infrastructure,[Go Network](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-network/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) .


The milestone reflects growing institutional adoption of a trading model designed to provide efficient access to liquidity while managing counterparty and operational risk. Clients execute on CROSSx, Crossover Markets’ execution-only electronic communication network, while BitGo serves as the central counterparty for clearing and settlement through Go Network under a single credit relationship. Assets are maintained in[qualified custody](https://www.bitgo.com/products/qualified-custody/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) through BitGo Bank & Trust.


“Surpassing $2 billion in cleared volume with Crossover Markets is an important milestone that reflects continued institutional demand for more efficient, risk-managed market infrastructure,” said Adam Sporn, Head of Prime Brokerage and U.S. Institutional Sales at BitGo. “Institutions want efficient access to liquidity without taking on unnecessary counterparty and operational risk. The growth we’ve seen on CROSSx through Go Network shows that this approach is resonating with the market.”


## Bringing traditional market structure to digital assets


Traditional financial markets generally[separate the functions involved in executing, holding, clearing, and settling assets](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/on-exchange-vs-third-party-crypto-custody/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) . Accessing an execution venue does not necessarily mean relying on that same venue to custody assets or perform every other function in the trading lifecycle.


Digital asset markets have historically operated differently. Accessing liquidity across exchanges has often required institutions to pre-fund individual venues, distributing capital across trading relationships and introducing additional counterparty and operational considerations.


BitGo and Crossover Markets[launched their relationship in 2025](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/go-network-and-crossover-markets-partnership/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) to provide another model. CROSSx provides anonymous, low-latency electronic execution and access to institutional liquidity, while BitGo provides the infrastructure for custody, credit, clearing, and settlement.


“As the digital asset market matures, serious institutions expect the same market structure and rules that they rely on in traditional markets,” said Anthony Mazzarese, Co-Founder and Chief Commercial Officer at Crossover Markets. “Combining CROSSx with BitGo's regulated settlement infrastructure is designed to deliver that structure, with clear separation between execution, credit, and settlement. We believe clients can access spot liquidity without taking counterparty exposure to the venue and without the conflicts of interest or information leakage that may arise with vertically integrated all-in-one providers.”


## What $2 billion in cleared volume means for institutions


The milestone shows this model operating at meaningful institutional scale.


Through the relationship, institutions can:


-


access CROSSx's anonymous, low-latency execution environment and institutional liquidity;


-


trade under a single credit relationship with BitGo serving as the central counterparty;


-


reduce the need to pre-fund or maintain assets with the execution venue;


-


maintain assets in qualified custody with[BitGo Bank & Trust](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/bitgo-secures-occ-approval/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) ; and


-


clear and net settle trades through Go Network.


For institutions expanding their trading activity, the model provides access to liquidity while keeping execution, custody, credit, clearing, and settlement as distinct but connected parts of the trading lifecycle.


The $2 billion milestone also represents continued growth for Go Network as BitGo connects institutional clients with a broader range of trading venues and counterparties through its settlement infrastructure.


## Access institutional liquidity without moving assets onto an execution venue.


[Contact the BitGo team](https://calendly.com/d/crmk-p2t-k78?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) to learn how CROSSx and Go Network can support your trading activity.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What does "$2 billion in cleared volume" mean?


The figure represents the cumulative notional value of trades executed through Crossover Markets' CROSSx and cleared and settled through BitGo.


### Where are client assets held when trading on CROSSx?


Assets remain within BitGo Bank & Trust's[qualified custody](https://www.bitgo.com/resources/blog/qualified-custody-vs-self-custody?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) environment until settlement rather than being moved onto CROSSx.


### What role does BitGo play in the transaction?


BitGo serves as the central counterparty and provides the credit, custody, clearing, and settlement infrastructure supporting client trading activity. Trades executed on CROSSx are cleared and settled through Go Network.


### What is Go Network?


Go Network is BitGo's institutional settlement infrastructure, connecting clients with trading venues and counterparties and supporting multiple settlement models.


### Does Go Network only support Crossover Markets?


No. CROSSx is one of multiple trading and settlement relationships supported through Go Network, which includes[delivery-versus-payment](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-network-dvp/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) and[off-exchange settlement models](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-network-oes/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=gonetwork&utm_campaign=crossxvolumemilestone) . Learn more here.
